notes.title: Epic Screenshot Contest! Win up to THREE copies of Overture!
notes.content:
We've been working hard on a huge update for you guys which includes controller support and a bunch of awesome new changes!

To celebrate, we're also holding a contest to see who can take the best Overture screenshots! (Press "Middle Mouse Button" or F12 in-game to take screenshots)

Instructions:
1. Play Overture, and take those screenshots
